fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Require the builder to preserve the complete command output and report zero or unavailable counts exactly; the specification already forbids invented results.
risks.description: The observation test script includes PostgreSQL-backed integration tests, so the isolated builder environment may lack a usable database even when the commit is sound.

risks.mitigation: Expand T1 evidence scope to the committed-config reader, ordered publisher, and delivery integration test identified in finding AN-002.
risks.description: Restricting T1 review to the two named implementation files can miss a regression in the ordered delivery path that actually reads and transmits the config.

body.summary: The audit is implementable with no blocking or ambiguous requirements. At PR head c7e326b7d1c7b03e8d051a079967d496b07e541f, T1 has direct defaulting and mapping evidence, and T2 has exact-claim fencing plus transactional completion evidence. One specification warning remains: T1 names only the domain parser and mapper even though ordered delivery depends on the committed-config reader and publisher; add those paths and their integration test to the audit evidence scope. The builder and assessor constraints are otherwise explicit and require no operator choice.

findings.description: T1 defaulting is concrete at the PR head: oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-41 gives RunConfig a boolean grading_enabled field, defaults an omitted field to false, and rejects non-booleans. oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 separately tests omitted, explicit, malformed, and launch-request cases.

T1 attributes ordered launch delivery only to run-config.ts and observation-mapping.ts, but the actual ordered path reads the persisted config and couples it to the event cursor in oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts:467-476 and oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-20,32-45. The replay/integration assertion is in oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209. Without adding these to T1 evidence scope, the assessor could satisfy the literal file list without verifying the full behavior claimed by the task.

T2 exact-claim settlement is directly supported at the PR head: observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:196-228 locks first and rechecks status, lease owner, attempt, and unexpired lease before the authoritative write; observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-90 carries the same ExecutionClaim across the provider boundary into completion or failure. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-355 separately covers expired, reclaimed, older-attempt, and lock-wait expiry cases.

T2 atomic completion is directly supported at the PR head: observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-292 updates the execution, closes the matching attempt, and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-243 forces the observation insert to fail and verifies that neither completion nor answer persists, then verifies the successful pair.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2, and keep analysis, plan, brief, build_result, and assessment as real observation artifacts.
T1 audits grading_enabled as a launch-config boolean that defaults off when omitted and is carried with the ordered launch delivery.
T2 audits settlement fencing to the exact current execution claim and transactional completion with its grade observation.

The builder detaches at origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2, inspects without edits, runs bun install only if needed, runs bun run --filter observation test exactly once, and reports actual output and counts without invention.
The builder publishes existing PR 791 and branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 without commits, pushes, PR mutation, merge, database reset, or deployment.
The assessor evaluates the same head commit, reports at least one finding per task, cites code as path:start-end and test or output evidence separately, and reports the builder run as test_evidence.
No brief introduces another operator choice or confirmation; the authorized audit path is final.

source_spec_refs: Audit purpose and isolated verification scope
Builder checkout, test, build_result, and existing-PR publication instructions
Assessor same-commit, per-task finding, code citation, and test_evidence instructions
No-edit, no-remote-mutation, no-deployment, and no-further-choice constraints

proposed_spec_updates.change: Change the T1 parenthetical evidence scope to include oakridge-dbos/src/storage/read-store.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts, and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts in addition to the two currently named files.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: Those paths read the exact committed config, attach it to the ordered event delivery, enforce cursor acknowledgement, and test replay; they are necessary to verify the full ordered-delivery claim rather than only parsing and mapping in isolation.
